title: Environment Badge
summary: Marks the page, tab title and favicon with the environment, so nobody edits production thinking it is staging.
description: Marks the page, tab title (kept through navigation) and favicon with PRODUCTION, STAGING or DEV (production hatched in red), reads names like "eu-prod-2" word by word, never calls an unknown environment safe, and includes a hook that asks for confirmation only in production.
catches: Working in production by mistake, via page, tab title and favicon marks
Environment names like "eu-prod-2", recognised word by word
Unknown environments, which are never shown as safe
limits: Only as accurate as the env value you pass
Marks the browser UI; it doesn't stop API calls made against production
a11y: The environment is written out in text; short codes are aria-hidden
The production confirmation is a native <dialog> labelled by its title, with the safe button focused
Production uses a hatch pattern as well as colour
server: Separate credentials and permissions per environment on the server; a badge is a reminder, not access control.
stops: Edited production thinking it was staging
